question: Who has been re-appointed as the MD and CEO of the RBL Bank in January 2021 for three years?
solution:
The correct answer is __Vishwavir Ahuja__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

__
 
• As per the March 2022,Rajeev Ahuja was appointed as interim MD & CEO on December 25, 2021 after its regular MD & CEO Vishwavir Ahuja proceeded on medical leave

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Vishwavir Ahuja has been re-appointed as the MD and CEO of the RBL Bank in January 2021 for three years.
 
• **RBL Bank**, also known as Ratnakar Bank, is an Indian private sector bank and its headquarter is located in Mumbai.
 
 
• RBL Bank was established in 1943.
 
• In 2016, RBL Bank launched a financial literacy program called Saksham in collaboration with the CDC to provide education to 25,000 individuals and 300 villages in four districts of Madhya Pradesh.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajeev Ahuja** has been appointed as **interim MD & CEO of RBI**
 
• On **August 6, 1943,** **Ratnakar Bank **was founded as a regional bank in** Maharashtra** with** two branches** in **Kolhapur **and **Sangli **founded by **Babgonda Bhujgonda Patil **from **Sangli** & **Gangappa Siddappa Chougule** from **Kolhapur.**
 
• In** 1959**, the bank was categorized as a **scheduled commercial bank** as per the **Reserve Bank of India Act, 1934.**
 
• In **July 2010**, **Vishwavir Ahuja** became **managing director** and **CEO of the bank**. In **August 2014 **the name of the bank was changed to **RBL Bank Limited.**
